_readme: Live pointer, read at page load. Edit on the server and refresh — no rebuild needed. There is no demo data any more; anything blank here simply has no source yet.
_rosterApiUrl: Server-side login lookup. /api/lookup is the Netlify function. Requires ROSTER_CSV_URL — and ADMIN_EMAILS for staff — in the SERVER environment.
_sheetId: Share link of the spreadsheet holding the trip content tabs (Trips, Itinerary, Documents, Guidelines, Reminders, Travel, Media). Build it from sample-data/Trip Data.xlsx. Until this is set, every grade reads 'Nothing published yet'.
_folderId: Alternative to sheetId: a Drive folder whose spreadsheets are matched BY FILE NAME. Needs driveApiKey. Deliberately blank — the school's existing 'Educational trips (25-26)' folder must NOT be used: it holds a trust deed, vendor agreements and police correspondence, and would have to be made public.
_csvBase: Local CSV files instead of Google, for development only. Blank in production.
_settingsTab: Tab in the trip spreadsheet holding per-source link overrides. Blank links mean 'use the tab of the same name'.
_gids: Only needed if a tab has been renamed — a gid survives renames and wins over the tab name.
_driveApiKey: Required for folderId, and for turning a folder link in the Documents tab into one card per file.
_adminEmails: Leave empty. Staff are configured via ADMIN_EMAILS in the server environment — this file is public, and listing staff here would tell anyone which address unlocks every grade.
